title: Symmetry of literal conflict
statement: Call two literals over a variable set *conflicting* when one is the positive and the other the negative occurrence of one and the same variable. For any two literals $l_1$ and $l_2$, $l_1$ and $l_2$ conflict if and only if $l_2$ and $l_1$ conflict; that is, the conflict relation is symmetric.
hypotheses_covered: two arbitrary literals l1 and l2 over a variable set
